trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move is corroborated by any newswire (Reuters/Bloomberg) on ceasefire talks; if no headline, treat as pure market noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare ITA move vs broad market (SPY) to isolate defense-specific reaction vs beta.
time_plan.2h: Watch European defense names (Rheinmetall, BAE) for confirmation of a sector-wide de-rating.
time_plan.6h: Re-assess whether the prediction-market move held or reverted; fade the thesis if probability mean-reverts.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate realized ITA return vs expectation; log whether leak hypothesis held given no public confirmation.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability that Ukraine cedes de facto control of Donbas would signal a credible move toward a negotiated end to the war. A peace/ceasefire narrative tends to pressure defense names as the 'war premium' and expectations of elevated munitions/procurement demand fade at the margin. ITA is a liquid, diversified proxy. However, Western defense budgets are multi-year and driven by broad rearmament (not just Ukraine), so exposure is partial and the move is likely modest and noisy over 12h.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check TTF/European gas futures direction directly if available; UNG is only a loose read-through.
time_plan.1h: Confirm whether any sanctions-relief or pipeline language appears in reporting.
time_plan.2h: Compare US vs European gas divergence to gauge whether the signal is geopolitical or weather-driven.
time_plan.6h: Reassess if probability move persists; drop thesis if no energy-market reaction.
time_plan.12h: Log realized move and whether the weak proxy produced any signal.

predictions.reasoning: A credible Russia-Ukraine settlement would ease European energy supply-fear and potentially reopen Russian gas flows over time, pressuring gas prices. The cleanest exposure is European TTF, not US Henry Hub; UNG (US natgas) is a weak proxy and US gas fundamentals are largely domestic (weather, LNG). Direction is plausible but the proxy linkage is poor, so confidence is low.

evidence_used: Prediction market question on Ukraine ceding de facto control of Donbas cities by end-2026
Market framing requires a publicly announced or consensus-reported diplomatic agreement
General macro linkage: Russia-Ukraine de-escalation lowers war-risk premium in defense and European energy
uncertainty_notes: A probability move in a 2026-horizon market has very weak timing relevance to a 12h asset window
Defense spending is driven by broad NATO rearmament, not solely the Ukraine war, limiting downside
US natural gas (UNG) is a poor proxy for the European gas channel that would actually react
No confirmation that any market anomaly reflects real non-public information vs noise/speculation

llm_justification.summary: A sharp upward move in the probability that Ukraine cedes de facto control of Donbas would signal progress toward a negotiated settlement, which at the margin pressures defense equities (fading war premium) and European gas (easing supply fear). But the resolution horizon is end-2026, the proxies are only partially exposed, and liquid US-listed instruments map poorly onto the European assets that would react most. Neither mapping clears the 700bps tradable threshold on a 12h window; both are low-confidence, noise-dominated reads.
key_assumptions: A probability spike reflects genuine diplomatic progress rather than speculation
Markets price de-escalation as reducing defense demand and energy risk
The move in the prediction market is near-term/news-driven enough to have 12h asset relevance
failure_modes: The move is already public (ongoing peace-talk headlines), so no leak edge exists
Defense budgets stay elevated regardless, so ITA does not fall
UNG is driven by US weather/LNG dynamics, decoupled from European geopolitical risk
The prediction-market move mean-reverts as a false signal
A 2026 resolution horizon makes any 12h asset reaction essentially undetectable above noise
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
